lines.label: The idea
lines.text: Within one session, the market stretched away from the session VWAP stops making new extremes; the signal is the first turn: a close through a fast average and beyond the bar before.

lines.label: A signal reads
lines.text: After a stretch below the session VWAP the lows stopped falling and the close turned up through the fast average and the bar before on the 5-minute chart.

lines.label: Runs on
lines.text: 5-minute, 1-minute, 3-minute or 15-minute bars; an idea never outlives its session.

lines.label: Exit options
lines.text: Your own settings: no fixed level, a multiple of your risk, the template's exit signal, a level (the session VWAP, the session high / low, the previous close).

long.text: (SessionVWAP() - close) >= $ext * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND close < SessionVWAP() AND low > Min(low, $no_new)[1]

short.text: (close - SessionVWAP()) >= $ext * ATR($atr_n)[1] AND close > SessionVWAP() AND high < Max(high, $no_new)[1]

template.idea: Within one session, the market stretched away from the session VWAP stops making new extremes; the signal is the first turn: a close through a fast average and beyond the bar before. The idea is wrong beyond the extreme.
template.name: VWAP reversal

params.help: How far the close is from the session VWAP, in average true ranges (0 means not set: any close on that side of VWAP).
params.label: Stretch from VWAP

params.help: The bars of the average true range the distances and buffers are measured in.
params.label: ATR period

params.help: The bar's low stays above the lowest low of this many bars before it (the high below the highest high for the downside).
params.label: No new extreme (bars)

params.help: The bars of the fast exponential average the turn closes through. Reference: 9 on the 1-minute chart.
params.label: Fast average

params.help: The turn must come within this many bars after the stretch, in the same session.
params.label: Turn within (bars)

params.help: The extreme since the stretch, the session's extreme, or the bar before.
params.label: The idea is wrong beyond

reads.long: After a stretch below the session VWAP the lows stopped falling and the close turned up through the fast average and the bar before on the 5-minute chart.
reads.short: After a stretch above the session VWAP the highs stopped rising and the close turned down through the fast average and the bar before on the 5-minute chart.

window_note: Only between: Not set - the whole session. Your own New entries from / until (Settings › Trade settings) applies if you set it.
